sources.title: JERA-selected map feature for Chiba Thermal Power Station address
sources.publisher: Google Maps; locator selected by JERA
sources.attribution: Google Maps; address feature selected by JERA
sources.summary: Exact selected address feature resolves to140.1019756,35.5638142. It locates the host plant address. AI-development plot is unpublished; no building centroid or boundary is inferred.

feature_review.review: Exact Google feature selected by iframe on JERA official Chiba Thermal Power Station page. Public browser UI address matches primary plant address. Feature coordinates differ from viewport center and are used as address-level host-campus locator, not a data-center building or plot.
